title: Exact spectral gap and unique crossover in Hagendorf’s odd twisted deformed t–J chain
description: Full Hamiltonian spectral gap for every odd chain length, twist pi and real |zeta| > 1, given by the smaller of an explicit pure-background wave and the lowest eigenvalue of an (N-1)-dimensional one-minority matrix. The two branches cross exactly once, with transition t_*(N)/N^2 tending to 4/pi^2. AI-assisted and internally checked; no peer review or priority claim.
